display.purpose: Headlines, self-hosted latin subset. Capped at 4.5rem so the hero holds two lines.

body.purpose: Reading copy and controls at a 66ch measure.

label.purpose: Stage numbers and measurement only, never texture.

wordmark.purpose: The arrival overlay only, capped at 6rem. The one step above the page ramp, and the surface's ceiling.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Every transition on the page, at 150ms or 300ms.

motion.name: globe-ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease as the globe turns to face a chosen guardian.

motion.name: globe-drift
motion.purpose: Idle rotation, slow enough to read and interruptible by drag.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Selection still reframes the globe; drift, packets and transitions stop.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Ink on near-black. One per section at most.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; gap:10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; padding:0 1.4rem; background:#f1f5f9; color:#0b1220; font:600 15px/1.2 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-primary:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a5b4fc; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Action
components.description: A hairline, for the secondary path.
components.css: .ds-outline { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; gap:10px; border:1px solid rgb(226 232 240 / .16); border-radius:999px; padding:0 1.4rem; background:transparent; color:#f1f5f9; font:600 15px/1.2 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-outline:hover { border-color:#94a3b8; background:rgb(226 232 240 / .035); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a5b4fc; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Guardian Chip
components.description: Toggle for one guardian. aria-pressed carries the state, not colour alone.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; gap:7px; border:1px solid rgb(226 232 240 / .16); border-radius:999px; padding:0 .9rem; background:transparent; color:#cbd5e1; font:600 15px/1.2 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color 150ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#94a3b8; color:#f1f5f9; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color:#6ee7b7; background:rgb(110 231 183 / .1); color:#f1f5f9; }

components.name: Signal Globe
components.description: Dot-matrix Earth from 1.6 KB of packed bits. Orthographic camera, so DOM markers sit exactly on the rendered sphere. Arcs stay lit when the tracker link drops, because carrier SMS is independent.
components.css: .ds-globe { position:relative; width:100%; max-width:31rem; aspect-ratio:1; margin-inline:auto; background:#070b14; cursor:grab; } .ds-globe-limb { position:absolute; inset:9.68%; border:1px solid rgb(226 232 240 / .09); border-radius:50%; } .ds-globe b { position:absolute; top:46%; left:52%; color:#f1f5f9; font:600 11px/1.3 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-globe b::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:-14px; top:50%; width:8px; height:8px; margin-top:-4px; border:2px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius:50%; }

narrative.northStar: One quiet field, one object that moves
narrative.overview: This page is read at night, often by someone who is uneasy. Everything on it is either a fact or a demonstration of a fact. The art direction is one near-black field, structure drawn in hairlines, and a single object that earns its weight: a dot-matrix globe showing one press in Bengaluru reaching five guardians. The globe is the argument, not the ornament: dropping its simulated internet connection leaves every arc lit and stops only the travelling tracker dot, because carrier SMS does not depend on an internet request.
keyCharacteristics: One dark ground. No second surface colour, no filled cards, no glass.
Structure is hairlines and space: three rule weights do all the dividing.
Bricolage Grotesque headings, Instrument Sans reading, mono only for sequence.
One signature object, built from data already in the repository.
Emerald means reached and safe; rose is emergency only; indigo marks the product.

rules.name: The Single Field Rule
rules.body: One ground colour carries the whole page. A section is separated by a rule and space, never by a second background.

rules.name: The Emergency Reserve Rule
rules.body: Rose appears only where someone could place a real call or where an alert is actually firing. Any other use spends the one colour the page cannot afford to make ambiguous.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If something needs separating, draw a 1px rule. A border above 1px, a filled card, or a shadow where a rule would do is the page reaching for weight it has not earned.

dos: Do let the globe explain something; every state it shows is a real product behaviour.
Do keep one ground colour and divide with rules and space.
Do reserve rose for emergency meaning and emerald for reached-and-safe.
Do verify at 1440x900 and 390x844, with reduced motion, with WebGL disabled, and by keyboard.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading. The heading carries itself.
Don't add a second surface colour, a filled card, or a shadow where a hairline works.
Don't let decoration imply a capability: no live location, no delivery confirmation.
Don't reintroduce a photographic globe texture; the dot matrix is 1.6 KB and needs no request.
